newsitem.title: USA: National City to close acquisition in Q1.
newsitem.headline: National City to close acquisition in Q1.

text.p: National City Bancshares Inc on Monday said it expected to complete its acquisition of First Federal Savings Bank of Leitchfield, Kentucky, during the first quarter of 1997.
The transaction was announced in October.
National City said the acquisition of First Federal, with assets of about $40 million, would give the company a greater presence in western Kentucky.
Last week, National City said it won approval of a restructuring plan for four affiliate banks. It said the plan would result in consolidation of four area banks into two larger community banks.
National City is the holding company for 11 banks.
